$comment: CAPTURE RECORDS for cinatra#2841 (PR #2866), in the shape
NONE OF THESE RECORDS IS REGISTERED IN scripts/ci/chat-hitl-capture-index.json, and the reason is
a FINDING about the contract rather than about the pictures: the contract requires a
recommendation_hold record to have observed [data-lifecycle-card="recommendation_hold"] and
[data-lifecycle-card-host="run_card"] in the captured frame, and the shipped card emits NEITHER
attribute anywhere - RunRecommendationChipRow / RecommendationHoldCard declare only
data-conformance-id="run-chip-row", data-run-recommendation-chip-row and the per-chip markers.
(ReviewGateCard does emit data-lifecycle-card-host; the recommendation card does not.) Every record
below therefore carries the count 0 it actually observed for those two anchors and the contract's
own verdict, rather than being edited to pass. Registering them would turn the gate red on a true
record, which is the opposite of what the gate is for.
